data.description:
## Context / Problem

Every recurrence of the schema-blind extraction class was diagnosed from a lucky console
capture; when the reask loop in src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py (prompted branch, :196-213)
exhausts `OUTPUT_RETRIES` today, the raw reply is discarded and the failure is not replayable.
The store's posture is that durable records carry no response text (usage-log precedent), so
capture must be opt-in and local — never a default, never in ticket events.

## Approach

On the FINAL structured-parse failure of the prompted reask loop, when the config key
`llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir` is set (read through the existing config loader,
src/rebar/config.py), write one timestamped file to that directory containing: the raw reply
text, the model id, the contract (response model) name, and the attempt count; then log the
artifact path in the failure message. Key unset (the default) -> behavior is byte-for-byte
today's. Document the key in docs/config.md. Default stated: artifacts rotate by count (keep
newest 20 per directory) so an unattended host cannot grow unbounded.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py — failure hook in the prompted branch
- src/rebar/config.py — the new key's read path (following the file's existing key pattern)
- docs/config.md — key documentation
- tests/unit/ (structured-run tests file) — contrast tests

## Testing

Unit tier with config-effect contrast (shared test-design standard §6), fault injected at the
parse seam (a reply fixture that fails all candidates, forcing retry exhaustion):

- Key set + forced final failure -> exactly one artifact exists containing the reply bytes and
  metadata; the raised error names the path.
- Key unset + same failure -> no artifact, error unchanged (negative control).
- Key set + successful parse -> nothing written (success negative control).
- Rotation: 21st artifact evicts the oldest.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Forced final parse failure with the key set writes exactly one artifact with reply +
      model id + contract name — checked by the new unit test.
- [ ] With the key unset the failure path is byte-for-byte unchanged and writes nothing —
      checked by the contrast test.
- [ ] A successful parse writes nothing even with the key set — checked by the negative
      control test.
- [ ] The key is documented with its default and rotation behavior — checked by the
      docs/config.md section existing and naming both.
data.title: Opt-in raw-reply artifact when structured parsing fails
